issues.FIRECRAWL_INDONESIA_EXPORT_PRICE_FALSE_E: NEW AND WORST CASE SO FAR, caught by manual verification. The firecrawl LAN egress serves the Indonesia storefront; for AmazonGlobal-Store items it returns the export price (here $106.19) with NO 'cannot be shipped' banner and NO ship_block flag, so the script reported a clean, asin_confirmed, in_stock $106.19 and recommended EDIT (+31.90%). The real US buybox is $87.28 (+8.41%). Had this been applied blindly, data.mjs would now show a price that no US buyer sees. The script's current fallback only triggers when NO price parses, so an export-priced page passes straight through. Fix candidates: (a) treat presence of 'Shipping & Import Charges to' or 'Deliver to Indonesia' as ship_block and force the jina fallback; (b) always cross-check any prospective EDIT (>=10 percent) against jina before applying. Recommend (a) plus (b). Unapproved.
